reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) discusses general HEA potential and magnetic properties of a different alloy system (FeMnCoCr), but provides no specific data on residual strains, their coupling to magnetostructural transitions, or annealing effects in FeMnNiGeSi HEAs. The key premises are therefore unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Residual microstructural strains and dislocation networks exist in as-deposited FeMnNiGeSi HEAs
These strains couple to the magnetostructural transition, making it sharp and hysteretic
Mild annealing can relieve these strains without causing phase separation
Strain relief broadens the transition and reduces hysteresis under low-field cycles
